description.en: Classic nostalgic pixel cat companion that delightfully chases your cursor.
description.zh: 随鼠标指针灵动追逐嬉戏的经典复古像素猫桌面伙伴 Web 组件。

content.en: Oneko brings the beloved 1989 classic desktop companion to the modern web. Packaged as a zero-dependency script, the nostalgic pixelated cat wakes up, runs playfully after the visitor's cursor, scratches the screen, and takes catnaps when the cursor stays idle.
content.zh: Oneko 将诞生于 1989 年经典的桌面像素猫猫伙伴带到了现代网页中。作为一个极轻量的零依赖前端脚本，这只惹人喜爱的复古小猫会在用户移动鼠标时飞奔追逐指针、在屏幕边缘挠墙爪击，并在停下时卷成一团惬意打呼噜，极富人情味与童趣。
